question: DeLallo avocado oil brand parent company
markdown:
The DeLallo avocado oil brand
does not have a separate corporate parent company
. It is owned, produced, and distributed directly by the
George DeLallo Company, Inc.
, a private, family-owned and operated Italian and Mediterranean specialty food business
founded in 1950 and headquartered in Pennsylvania, United States.
